name: magpie-cnb2api
description: Serve the cnb2api running in your own CNB workspace as a magpie provider: keeps up with the drifting *.cnb.run address, restarts the workspace when it stops, shows the workspace's real AI credits and core-hours, and keeps one account per user + org/repo.

summary.en: Turns the cnb2api in your own CNB workspace into a magpie provider. The workspace address changes on every restart and the workspace gets stopped by the platform — this follows the address and starts it again. It also shows the workspace's real AI credits and core-hours, and keeps one account per user and org/repo.
summary.zh: 把你自己的 CNB 工作区里的 cnb2api 接成 magpie 供应商。工作区每次重启地址都会变、停了就完全没响应——插件负责跟住地址、并在停了之后把工作区拉起来；顺带把工作区的真实 AI credits 和核时显示到用量面板，多账号按「用户 + 组织/仓库」各算一个。
